title: Cramér's Conjecture on Prime Gaps
statement_plain: Let p_n be the n-th prime. Cramér's conjecture asserts that the gap between consecutive primes satisfies p_{n+1} - p_n = O((log p_n)^2) — and in Cramér's stronger 1936 probabilistic formulation, limsup_{n -> infty} (p_{n+1} - p_n) / (log p_n)^2 = 1 (though Granville's 1995 heuristic suggests >= 2 e^{-gamma} ~ 1.1229).
